posts.subject: Reintroducing 35hp knife GAMEMODES
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Admin Community.


I wanted to reintroduce to other knife admins (Mainly knife) to make the server more fun which are ( Myself, @WHAT, @Luckiris, @Raven ) to make fun gamemodes that DooDoo [bb*] came up with.




GAMEMODE: Deathmatch
INSPIRED BY: KermitOS (RIP [Bild] )
RULES: Gangbanging is allowed. Spawn killing is ESPECIALLY not allowed. [Bild]
SUMMARY: Simple, every player will get respawned more or less straight after they die. Players are able to simply kill whoever they see so therefore gangbanging is allowed during this gamemode ONLY. However, many people will be scared about losing their points and rank so I advise you to go spectator for that round.
ADMIN NOTES: Allow gangbangs and try to bind a key so that you can respawn all quickly - correct me if I'm wrong but it's something like: bind "key" "say /respawn @all" . Many players usually get tired of this gamemode after 1-2 rounds of excessive respawning. Try to do this game mode on a large map although small maps are feasible too.



GAMEMODE: Legends
INSPIRED BY: Doo Doo [Bild]
RULES: Normal rule apply. DON'T gangbang the legends and do not move to the legend's team if you are not a legend. [Bild]
SUMMARY: During the first 5 rounds of the new map, tryhard, do your best to be the best on your team! The top (1,2 or 3 players - depending on how many players are on the server e,g, 10 players = 2 legends) will become the 'legend'. If you are a legend, it means that you and your high scoring peers will be moved to a team alone full of legends. As part of the legends team, you will be always at a player disadvantage, which means you need to use your skills displayed earlier to take down the others. As part of the unlucky people who didn't get to become a legend for this time, your aim is to avenge yourself and kill those legends, redeem yourself as worthy and scream "I DESERVED TO BE A LEGEND [Bild] "
ADMIN NOTES: Record the top (1,2 or 3) players on each team and move them towards one team (I usually move them to CT) you can either use the admin menu --> move commands --> move after round-end to move them or simply use the command !swapt or !swapct playername to move them (note that this command will move them without slaying them - anyone know the command to swap them at the end of the round? [Bild] ). Ensure both the legend's and other's safety and dont let them gangbang or be gangbanged. Try to do this game mode on a large map (e.g. 35hp_oldschool, 35hp_$2000$ v2, 35hp_gladiators or even 35_spartans)



GAMEMODE: Hostage
INSPIRED BY: Doo Doo [Bild]
RULES: Gangbanging is allowed. [Bild]
SUMMARY: First of all, there will be some sort of mini-game to determine who will be the first 'Hostage' for example, "First one to say 'PewDiePie' in chat will become Hostage!". The first CT and T to say the specified word will get to become the Hostage. The Hostages will be beaconed (a small pulse around a player) to signify their importance and your aim is TO KILL THE ENEMY HOSTAGE [Bild] . No matter whatever it takes, kill them, gangbang your way through their defences and go straight for the kill or playing safe and protecting your own Hostage [Bild] . The player that kills the FIRST Hostage wins a prize (some credits, usually 100 or 500 - note that this prize will only be for the first round unless admins are feeling generous and rich [Bild] . After the first round, the admin may choose Hostages at random and the game goes on until players get tired of it or until a new map.
ADMIN NOTES: Think of something to say for the first round of Hostage, of course, try to be sensible. See who wrote it first and check if they are on different teams, if two players say it from T, the first one will become Hostage and look for the first CT so they can become Hostage. Simply beacon the Hostages at the start of the round and enjoy. After the first round, you may pick Hostages at random but try to pick players who are familiar with the gamemode and is regular on the server.

In my opinion, these are pretty bad ideas.


As far as I know you can't disable the gang bang plugin as an admin, so some of these ideas won't be possible to play.
Also they could only be played if an admin is online.
Typing all the commands is very time consuming and maybe difficult.
These ideas are planned badly, in my opinion.

Well @CyberTroniX these gamemodes were hosted by Doo Doo, Me and What before and they went flawlessly, also people still get gang banged so I don't think the plugin is still in use anymore after having problems with it.


Also that's why there are "ADMIN NOTES" and "Rules" so all admin have to do is enforce the rules for a certain gamemode.
Mabye we could make a plugin to automate the mode like enabling auto-respawn, auto random-pick players ...

@Luckiris I don't think there is any need for new plugin's as before all the gamemmodes went smooth for Doo Doo, Me or WHAT smooth with 17 or even more players, it depends on a admin if he can handle this.

I know that, I already did a few times those gamemodes without any big problems.


I just think that it would be easier to have something to do the job like in the deathmatch mode, the plugin respawn every dead player without needing to type /respawn @all every time.


It would spam less the log and save some CPU.
I think it's good idé to tell these again cause doing game modes make people happy and alot of them enjoy them aswell and it just makes a better reputation for dream overall
